subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.description: This company's plan and access state, read straight from the server.
subscription.emptyDescription: This company has no subscription record yet. Onboard the enterprise to create one, then return here.
subscription.serverNote: Every value on this page comes from the server. Nothing here is editable in the browser.
subscription.operationalHint: Operational access is granted: purchases, payments and stock writes are accepted for this company.
subscription.blockedHint: Operational writes are refused while access is blocked. Users can still sign in and manage their account.
subscription.activateDescription: Operational access is restored for every user in {{company}}. The company returns to active and a fresh 365-day period begins.
subscription.suspendDescription: Every user in {{company}} loses operational access immediately. They can still sign in and manage their account, but purchases, payments and stock movements are refused.
subscription.closedNotice: This company account is closed. A closed account is an end-of-life state and cannot be reactivated from this screen.

platform.heading: Subscriptions across enterprises
platform.description: Every company on this server and the current state of its plan.
platform.noTenant: The subscription endpoint answers for the signed-in company only, and this account is not scoped to one. Every company and its plan are listed below instead.
platform.emptyDescription: Onboard an enterprise and its subscription will appear here.
